Priyom —

Confirmed engineering is fine for Wed 07/28 14:00–14:30 PT but asks that we (1) keep the agenda tight (30m), (2) share the brief Appendix note on prefix/KV caching beforehand, and (3) limit participants to 3 internal Redwood folks to avoid scope creep. I'm available to join. I'll prepare the 1-paragraph primer on prefix caching (from redwood-demo-appendix.md) and paste below for the invite: 

"Prefix/KV caching note (one-paragraph): For streaming workloads we recommend enabling prefix (KV) caching on the inference endpoint to retain encoder/key-value state between adjacent requests from the same session. This reduces repeated computation on earlier tokens, cutting per-token latency and cost for follow-up generations. Cache eviction is LRU-based with configurable TTL; we can tune the TTL per session to balance freshness and memory footprint."

If Ellie confirms, I'll send the calendar invite and attach both files.

—Marissa
